consent.statement: Priya Sharma, CISO, on behalf of Acme Corp, authorises a Quantum Bill of Materials assessment of samples/vulnerable-app against a target post-quantum readiness of 80.0%, understanding that raw findings never leave the organisation's own infrastructure (see the zero-trust attestation layer).

remediation_applied.title: Restrict nginx to TLS 1.3 with a hybrid PQ key-exchange group
remediation_applied.summary: Dropped TLS 1.0/1.1/1.2 entirely. Added a hybrid classical+ML-KEM group (X25519MLKEM768) alongside the classical fallback. Replaced the legacy dash-separated cipher-suite string (which implied static-RSA key transport and still listed RC4/3DES) with the standard TLS 1.3 suite names.

remediation_applied.title: Raise default_bits, drop RC4, add a hybrid PQ group
remediation_applied.summary: default_bits raised to 3072 (classical hygiene only -- RSA of any size stays Shor-vulnerable; this does not by itself move the readiness needle, and the report says so). CipherString no longer names RC4/legacy static-RSA suites. Added a Groups= directive enabling a hybrid ML-KEM group (OpenSSL 3.2+).

remediation_applied.title: Re-issue legacy_partner.crt as ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204)
remediation_applied.summary: A certificate's signature algorithm cannot be hand-edited -- it is re-issued, exactly as a PKI/CA team would. Signed with ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204): this is a genuine post-quantum-safe certificate, not an interim step.

remediation_applied.summary: Same reasoning as the signing key: EC P-256 alone is Shor-breakable, so the replacement is a hybrid KEM, not a different curve.

remediation_applied.title: Re-issue modern_service.crt as ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204)
remediation_applied.summary: modern_service.crt was already today's classical best practice (EC P-256/SHA-256) -- not urgent, which is why this is the lowest-priority action in the catalog. Re-issued as ML-DSA-65 now that PQ certificate tooling is available, completing the wave.

remediation_applied.title: Migrate payments signing key RSA-1024 -> ML-DSA-65
remediation_applied.summary: RSA is Shor-breakable at any key size, so this is a real algorithm migration, not a bigger key: signing now uses ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) via the liboqs-python API shape.

remediation_applied.title: Replace MD5/SHA-1 with SHA-256
remediation_applied.summary: Swapped classically-broken digest calls for SHA-256 at each call site. No key-management change needed -- this is a same-shape replacement.

remediation_applied.title: Replace DES/3DES and ECB mode with AES-256-GCM
remediation_applied.summary: DES/3DES block ciphers and unauthenticated ECB mode replaced with AES-256 in an authenticated (GCM) mode. `encrypt_card_batch` now takes an explicit nonce, matching the AEAD pattern already used elsewhere in this codebase.

remediation_applied.title: Harden sshd_config key exchange, ciphers, MACs, host keys
remediation_applied.summary: Dropped diffie-hellman-group1-sha1 and curve25519-sha256 from KexAlgorithms, keeping the already-present hybrid PQ group (sntrup761x25519). Dropped 3des-cbc and hmac-sha1. Dropped the legacy ssh-rsa host key, keeping ssh-ed25519 -- OpenSSH has no standardised post-quantum host-key algorithm yet, so this one item is a documented residual, not a fix.
